svg.title: Overdraw heatmap
svg.text: The Big Catch in an overdraw view
Each cell's colour = how many see-through layers are painted there (2 murk layers + splash particles).
The splash is 240 particles. The 10 foam puffs right at the lens are about 800 px wide: 4% of the
particles, 69% of the painted pixels. Particle count says little; pixels painted say everything.
